scope: Whole instructional sequence design for text and native activities. Text item probes cover single-best choices/evidence selection, unique-category classification and open responses. Native per-format semantic correctness, actual served exposure, child difficulty and runtime marking are unqualified.
review: Review the full instructional sequence in a separate stateless call before item probes. Solve items without author keys, future teaching or teacher evidence claims. Review candidate feedback, source relations and rubrics separately. Preserve all samples; any uncertainty, unavailable sample or contradiction vetoes a decisive criterion. Missing plans, checks and draws never become approval.
repetition: Fresh child processes with identical frozen packets, code and config. Report observed variation; model aliases do not establish an immutable serving revision.
